name: @xshieldai/agent-kernel
description: Agent Kernel (formerly KavachOS) — seccomp-bpf + Falco kernel enforcement for AI agents. Core kernel-enforcement primitive of the xShieldAI Posture Suite.
author: Capt. Anil Sharma <capt.anil.sharma@powerpbox.org>

scripts.build: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const s=require('fs').readFileSync('../../src/kavachos-cli.ts','utf8');const m=s.match(/const KAVACHOS_VERSION = \"([^\"]+)\"/);if(!m) {console.error('KAVACHOS_VERSION constant not found in the CLI');process.exit(1)}if(m[1]!==p.version){console.error('version drift: package.json '+p.version+' vs CLI '+m[1]+' — update both');process.exit(1)}" && bun build ../../src/kavachos-cli.ts --target=bun --external @aws-sdk/client-s3 --outfile=dist/kavachos.js && cp ../../src/kernel/cgroup-egress.py dist/cgroup-egress.py && cp ../../src/kernel/apply-seccomp.py dist/apply-seccomp.py
